title: Dami_Aria`s BedWars Pack
description: Resource pack from a cute streamer Dami_Aria for BedWars
body: Hi, my little flames🔥! This is my personal texture pack, created with love for you and for a cozy Bedwars game! 💖 All the wool blocks have been transformed into cute ones with beautiful flame textures, and I made the items and interface in warm fiery shades.
